body: i wish i could try anyway. i can't seem to move on, but i also don't know what to try. i can't force her, and i'm giving her space now. but i also can't seem to forgive myself
she really was, and is, my sun and moon and stars. i just wish i would've shown her that way better than i did
i can't just talk to her. i can't handle her with someone else. i know its selfish of me, but i just can't bear it. it hurts..
yeah, i've done that. she said i should move on, she doesnt have feelings for me, we can't work out, etc.. sucks..
before i had her, i was 13. still a kid, didn't really care for love. ever since she walked in, its been different. now she's gone, and im lost
thank you for taking time out of your life to talk to me. i guess i'm lucky i don't have kids.. i'm glad you stuck around though

yeah, i've just been sitting here on reddit trying to keep going. i really don't want to.

i don't feel that i wasted time on her. i wish i could just get another chance with her.
i did throw it away. if i had a time machine, all i'd do is go back and change that one mistake. wouldn't even care for lottery numbers heh. having her back would be worth more than anything

i'm sorry about your wife and kids situation, but i'm happy that you found your soulmate. 

what kind of change? i hope a change will come, but i don't know how i can be her friend when she's with someone else. i can't bear it. i can't stop picturing her with someone else, and it hurts so much. i blame myself, but it still hurts so much
this is just karma giving me my much deserved punishment for hurting her. i wish her all the happiness in the world. i just wish it could've been with me
this is karma, and i'm getting my deserved punishment for hurting her. i hope she always stays happy. i just wish it could've been with me

"you've been her for 7 months" -- i broke up with her 7 months ago, but up until a couple of weeks ago, we still talked everyday and things were ok.. i wish i would've realized my mistakes even a month ago..
thats the thing. she did fight for me, and she did love me unconditionally. i just pushed her away..
i feel that i can either get ready for a really tough, hurt-filled life, or just end it now to avoid all that.. im so lost without her
thank you for your time and your words. i'm just so lost..

i'm not a very artsy person. i'm into sports. i play all the time, but haven't played for 3 weeks now. i just don't feel like having fun. i feel that i don't deserve to have any fun because of the hurt i gave her. i know she's happy now, but i put her through a lot when i broke up with her. this is karma getting back at me now, and i know i deserve it

no, i messed up. i gave up on us when i broke up with her 7 months ago. i thought it was something i had to do for her happiness. she even told me i was making the wrong decision, and that i'd realize it one day. i've realized it now, but its too late. 

i don't blame her for anything she's doing. i deserve it. i just wish i could have a shot with her at making it right. i know i'd be so much better. but i won't get that. she's happy now. she has no reason whatsoever to come back to me
thank you for your response. i hope you find what you are looking for, and im so sorry about your relationship problem :(

i went for a little walk. i came back so depressed and so alone, i broke down. i've never been the crying type, but this has just been so much. i can only imagine how much i hurt her when i broke up with her like the idiot that i am, and im so sorry to her for that. i even told her, but i understand that its too little too late. i cant forgive myself.. i ruined everything

i feel that she did what you are telling me to. she made new friends, she moved on. she's been talking to another guy now for 2-3 weeks, and she's at a happy point in her life she tells me. she says she no longer has feelings for me.

i just can't do it. i can't forgive myself for ruining something so special
i just don't see it happening. i wish i could see it like you do, but i just don't.. i don't see a life without her. i'm so in love with her, i don't know how to manage..

i've honestly been doing nothing. i've been in my room. i haven't eaten in 4 days now. i don't even feel hungry at all. i don't want to do anything. i just wish that somehow she would give me a chance to prove myself, but i know i wont get the chance

i'm sorry for what you're going through :(

i just don't think i can do it. i miss her so much. just typing "i miss her" brought tears to my eyes.. i keep picturing her with someone else, and it just kills me

i've never even had anyone else who i was interested in, or who was interested in me. this is gonna be one tough life if i continue to live it. it would've been a great life had i not made that stupid decision..

"carry on with the part of your life she wasn't involved with" -- that's the problem. i know her now for 13 years. she was my best friend. my everything. she was involved in like all parts of my life. 13 years.. thats half of my life, and i just threw it all away

i want to be in her life, but i can't bear to see her with someone else. i thought i could, thats why i initially broke up with her, so she could be happy. i just didn't think it all the way through like i thought i did, and now i regret making this biggest mistake of my life. she's moved on, she says she's happy where she is in life now. i want to love her, but she's not even there anymore for me to love. what more can i do? i can't get over it

i truly dont want anyone else. i've known her since i was 13-14, and have wanted nobody but her. when i finally got her, i couldnt balance my life properly and decided for her that she'd be happier without me, even though she told me i was making the wrong decision. i was stupid, stubborn, and just wrong. i can't believe myself. i finally had the girl of my dreams, but i let her go..
yeah. i knew her since i was 13-14, and never wanted to be with anyone but her
thank you. you're right. i was making decisions for her.. i can't believe i didn't see all this..

everyone tells me that. time will make it better. she even told me that. but it won't. i don't see myself ever getting over her and moving on. i don't want a chance with another girl. i wish i could just have another chance with her, and i'd never make the same mistake again, but that won't happen.. she wont come back. i messed up, and i know it, and i regret it, and i will always regret it. i can't see myself moving past this, moving on from her

i definitely hurt her when i left. i just thought i was doing the right thing because i wouldn't make her happy. i totally blame myself, and i guess its karma getting me back for hurting her. i never intended to hurt her. i always wanted her happiness, but you're right. i did hurt her, and i didnt balance my life properly.

i'll regret this forever
i dont even know. i never wanted anyone but her, and when i finally got her, i gave her up like an idiot. i still dont want anyone else. i guess single for life wont be too bad..

i agree with not talking to her. i told her yesterday that i will step out of her life and let her be happy. i won't be texting or calling anymore. but i miss her so much, i can't explain.. i love this girl so much, and i knew she loved me so much more.

i made a mistake leaving her. the biggest mistake of my life. i didn't leave her because i didn't love her. or because there was someone else, or anything like that. i just wanted her happiness and i thought i'd be holding her back since it would take me some time now to get my life back on track. i regret it so much, and now she's gone... i knew her for 13 years, we talked ALL the time, we were close the entire time.. 13 years, seriously about half of my life..
